title: LayoutProfile
description: Structure-identity keys for a layout profile (L0/L1/L2). additionalProperties: false per PF-B3.

profile.description: Profile name or ID (structure-identity key, not overridable by paper config)

kind.description: Profile kind (structure-identity key, not overridable by paper config)

target_venue.description: Target venue identifier (structure-identity key, not overridable by paper config)

typography.description: Typographic settings (optional). Per PF-B3 the draft defaults (12pt body, 1.5x line spacing) are overridable, so this key is NOT a structure-identity key and may be set by paper config.

body_pt.description: Body font size in points (draft default: 12)

east_asia_font.description: East Asian (CJK) font family name (draft default: Noto Serif SC)

latin_font.description: Latin font family name (optional; omit to let the build toolchain fall back to its default serif)

citation.description: Citation style settings (structure-identity key, not overridable by paper config)

formulas.description: Formula rendering settings (structure-identity key, not overridable by paper config)
